description: Move ONE prompt to another repo and/or folder. `name` must be the exact title or the id. Its versions, deployment labels, stars, usage and its /p/ short link stay with it; tags are matched by name in the target repo (created if missing). `to_project` = target repo (omit to stay in the same repo; then pass `folder`). `folder` = target folder like reviews/backend (omit: kept in the same repo, repo root in another; "" = the repo root). Refused, with nothing moved, when the target repo already has a prompt with that title, or when the move changes who can see the prompt (public <-> private repo): ask the user, and only if they agree call again with confirm_visibility: true. Moving to where it already is changes nothing. Needs editor or owner on both repos. This tool never deletes a prompt, a version or a tag.

confirm_visibility.description: true only after the user agreed to a move that changes who can see the prompt

folder.description: Target folder, e.g. reviews/backend; "" for the repo root; omit to keep it (same repo) or use the root (another repo)

name.description: Exact prompt title, or its id / short id

project.description: Repo name, slug, or id to find the prompt in when titles collide

to_project.description: Target repo name, slug or id (omit to stay in the same repo)

name: move_prompt
title: Move a prompt to another repo or folder
